notes.title: Major Update: Enhanced Customization, Interactions, and Future Plans
notes.content:
[u][b]Character Selection & Customization:[/b][/u]

We’ve implemented a new character selection screen with four unique characters—each featuring its own story, playstyle, and Core deck.
Players can further tailor their experience by picking 2 bonus cards out of 4, and choosing 1 passive from each of 3 categories (with a total of 7 passives available).

[u][b]New Effects & Visuals:[/b][/u]

A host of new effects and cards have been added to deepen gameplay.
We’ve also created and updated many icons to enhance the overall visual experience.

[u][b]Enhanced In-Game Interactions:[/b][/u]

[b]Campsite[/b]: Choose between a priest (restores a large amount of health), a guru (restores plenty of mana), a shaman (provides a bit of both), or simply claim extra gold.

[b]Altar[/b]: Pick from two powerful passives to boost your character.

[b]Blacksmith[/b]: Decide whether to upgrade an item or sacrifice two items to craft a brand-new piece of gear.

[b]Shrine[/b]: Upgrade one of your passives for an extra edge.

[b]Treasure Room[/b]: Select a relic from three distinct options.

[u][b]Upcoming Features:[/b][/u]

[b]Shop[/b]: An in-game shop will let you buy and sell cards and items, expanding your strategic options.

[b]Enchanter[/b]: Soon, you’ll be able to add a chosen effect from a set of options to one of your cards.
Future Plans:

A major refactor of the world map is in the works, promising to transform how you explore and interact with the game world. Stay tuned for more details on that!

notes.title: Progression Update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Sharing the main changes to Journey To Natsai in the past 4 weeks:[/b][/h3]

[b][u]Done[/u] [/b]:   

- Another improvement to the enemies predictions.
- Now there is in-game menu.
- Fixed a few bugs.
- Added currency to the game.
- Added animations for mechanical worm boss.
- Added animations for horse and ogre elites.
- Sound discovery - my main time consumer this month.
- Started to work on the UI concept for the character equipment and deck editing.

Thank you for the time and stay tuned for more,
Cheers.

notes.title: Second mile stone has ended - first act and character progression!
notes.content:
Around 3 weeks ago I generated 20 keys to Journey To Natsai for testing and feedbacks purpose, I want to thank everyone who toke part and helped me to know how to keep improve my game.

Apart from this here are some of the changes I made since my last update. 

- Added a boss fight at the end of the act.
- Added 2 elite monsters.
- Added the ability to create cards that there effect has a chance to happen.
- Added some hover effects.
- Tile map ordering is now better.
- Map can also be scrolled by mouse scroller.
- Fixed some tutorial spelling issues.
- Added the ability to create movement cards with more then one option.
- Fixed a bug that happened when the player killed the monster and died at the same time.

Best regards.

notes.title: First Trailer + Game Progression Update
notes.content:
First of all, I'm very excited to announce that finally I have a trailer for Journey To Natasi!

Second as I promised here are the changes from my last announcement: 

- Better AI for enemies, will still need improvements in the future but overall much better.
- Monster without reasonable moves will make valid move even if its not a good one.
- Fixed 3 bugs.
- Added skill images for some cards.
- Improved the animation system to be more generic.
- Added basic animations for a lot of cards use.
- Added VRX for many cards.
- Movement cards can now deal damage.
- Added textual feedback when receiving effect for some effects (poison, bleeding and more).
- Added textual feedback when receiving damage.
- Effects description shows now if pointing at the effect icon.
- Changed the way the inspect work on the promo cards.

Best regards.

[b][u]In Progress[/u] [/b]:

- Simple temporary trailer for the Steam page.

Should upload the trailer in the next few days, 
Best regards.
